source.title: Blender References Not Working | How To Set Up References Tutorial
source.creator: 3DTudor

analysis.study_scope: Reference image import alignment, orthographic axis snapping, multi-plane reference cross-setup, and wireframe viewport verification.

episodes.problem: Importing reference images in perspective view causes axis misalignment.
episodes.observed_fact: Shift+A reference import in perspective view creates an image plane tilted relative to world coordinates.
episodes.instructor_claim: Adding references in perspective view aligns them to camera tilt rather than world axes.
episodes.interpretation: Blender aligns imported reference empties to the viewport angle.
episodes.hypothesis: Non-orthographic imports require manual transform reset to align with world grid.
episodes.reference_evidence: Reference plane is angled along perspective view vector.
episodes.visible_action: Press Shift+A, select Image -> Reference, import Market stall.jpg, rotate view.
episodes.spoken_reason: Show how perspective import causes unwanted rotation.
episodes.failure: Importing image in perspective view yields misaligned reference plane.
episodes.correction: Delete reference plane and switch to orthographic view.
episodes.alternatives: Manually zero out rotation transform values.
episodes.transferable_principle: Align viewport to an orthographic axis before importing reference images.

episodes.problem: Setting up axis-aligned reference images for modeling.
episodes.observed_fact: Numpad 1 switches to Front Orthographic view. Importing image creates axis-aligned reference. Duplicating and rotating 90 degrees on Z creates cross-plane references.
episodes.instructor_claim: Numpad 1 front view ensures proper reference alignment, while 90-degree duplication allows multi-angle view in wireframe.
episodes.interpretation: Orthographic import locks plane perpendicular to view vector.
episodes.hypothesis: Cross-plane reference setup improves perspective matching during blockout.
episodes.reference_evidence: Reference image aligns to Front view plane and stays orthogonal upon duplication.
episodes.modeling_decision: Set up dual orthogonal reference planes.
episodes.visible_action: Press Numpad 1, Shift+A -> Image -> Reference, scale image, Shift+D, Enter, R Z 90, Add Cube, press Z -> Wireframe.
episodes.spoken_reason: Align reference properly and duplicate 90 degrees for multi-angle referencing.
episodes.transferable_principle: Import references in orthographic views and duplicate along orthogonal axes for multi-view referencing.
